fastembed_runtime.note: fastembed 0.8.0 first calls download_files_from_huggingface with local_files_only=True, so a complete TMPDIR cache loads without an external network call; the sandbox denies external network anyway. It falls back to a remote metadata/download path only if the local cache is incomplete. FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH/HF_HUB_OFFLINE are not forwarded by launch_server, so the effective path is the inherited TMPDIR/fastembed_cache. No model is started here.
